items.title: Why More Crypto Can Mean Less Crypto Per Treasury Share
items.summary: Selling new common shares above net asset value can increase assets per share.

items.title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
items.summary: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.

items.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
items.summary: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

items.title: Polygon adds Solana to payment stack linking bank accounts, crypto and payouts
items.summary: Polygon added Solana to its payments platform, connecting businesses to bank funding, cross-chain transfers, stablecoins and global payouts.
